rules-international.title: International rules

config.intro: Contacts with other countries: what do the rules say?

cases.situation: Chatting with a Japanese amateur about your antenna and the weather.
cases.why: Amateur purposes and personal remarks are allowed.

cases.situation: A country has registered an objection with the ITU.
cases.why: Contacts are permitted unless an administration objects.

cases.situation: Besides Canadian law, whose radio regulations bind you?
cases.why: The ITU's Radio Regulations apply to Canadian amateurs.

rules-international.success: Personal and amateur topics, with any country that hasn't objected, under ITU rules too.
